text:
Emma: Quick ask — GreenSky (enterprise POC) wants hosted usage pricing exception. Estimate ~1.8B tokens over 3 months. They asked for per-token = $0.00045 vs our list $0.00060 and no min for the POC. Can we do a temporary override? @Lisa @Matt
Raj: model / perf details? which model and SLA do they expect?
Emma: They'll use `redwood-2-large` for generation, peak ~220 RPS, avg seq len ~512. Need streaming. Customer wants us to avoid a commit, they're evaluating feature fit.
Raj: technically fine on hosted. We should pin the model and add automatic fallback to `redwood-2-medium` if capacity spikes. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching to reduce tokens — could drop billable tokens by ~8-12% for repeated prompts.
Lisa: Deal desk rules: we can consider a per-token override for POCs but need finance + sales director sign-off and a cap on total discounted spend. What's the expected ARR conversion if they buy?
Emma: Conversion probability ~35% to Dedicated within 12 months; if converted, they'd be ~$120k/mo committed.
Matt: Finance view: we can approve a temporary discount if (a) it's limited to 90 days, (b) total discounted charge capped at $30k, and (c) we include a minimum recovery fee if they exceed traffic patterns. Alternatively we can do a 25% off for first 90 days with no min.
Lisa: OK. Proposed terms to present to customer: 1) 90-day POC discount: per-token $0.00045, capped at $30k total discounted spend; 2) If usage in any month exceeds the cap allocation, standard list pricing resumes for the remainder of that month; 3) Include a required technical checklist and pinning + fallback policy.
Emma: Copying suggested contract snippet for legal:```
"Hosted POC Pricing: Customer will be billed at $0.00045 per token for a 90-day evaluation period, subject to a maximum discounted invoice amount of $30,000. Usage beyond the capped amount will be billed at standard list rates. No long-term commit is required as part of this evaluation. All billing is subject to Redwood Inference Terms."
```
Nora: Security note — verify they don't require on-prem keying. For hosted POC we need to confirm that logs are retained only in us-east-1 and that customer data classification allows cloud processing. If they require VPC-only, this won't be a simple hosted POC.
Emma: I asked them: they said no KMS requirement for POC, but they will sign a short DPA.
Matt: Also suggest adding a minimum monthly recovery of $2k if usage pattern shows heavy bursting that drives capacity allocation. Makes sense?
Lisa: Approve conditionally. I'll draft the deal desk approval email. Conditions: 90 days, $0.00045 per-token, $30k discount cap, $2k recovery min if monthly peak > 3x baseline, engineering sign-off on pinning/fallback, and security confirms log/location. @Raj @Nora please ack.
Raj: Ack — will add model pin + fallback and a one-time config flag to enable prefix caching for this customer.
Nora: Ack — will confirm DPA + region retention. If security flags anything, I'll post back.
ci-deploy-bot: billing-rule-created: rule_id=br-20260312-84, scope=customer:greensky, discount=0.00015/token, cap=30000, expires=90d
Emma: Thanks all — I'll share the updated proposal and contract language with the customer by EOD. :thumbsup:
Lisa: I'll prepare the approval email and loop in Legal for the DPA.
Matt: I'll note finance metrics and tracking in the forecast sheet.
Emma: (closing) moving to external thread with customer now.
